title: Pin that webkit-verify's inspect() lets a focus-ring failure fail the run
evidence: From PR 1704's review (R4). tools/webkit-verify.test.ts's exit-code test ('H90: the gate exits non-zero when the focus step throws at top level') spawns its own script that awaits probeFocusRing, so it proves Node's unhandled-rejection exit, not webkit-verify's wiring. If someone wraps the probeFocusRing call in inspect() (around tools/webkit-verify.mjs:412) in a try/catch, all the H90 tests still pass. Remedy: drive inspect() with a fake browser, or pin that the call is not wrapped. (H100)
